mapper.select: SELECT w.WISH_ID, w.CREATED_AT, w.USER_ID, w.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRICE, i.IMG_URL AS imgUrl FROM WISHLIST w INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON w.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE w.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY w.CREATED_AT DESC, w.WISH_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO WISHLIST (USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISHLIST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WISHLIST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
